messages:
maya: heads-up, CloudWave flagged that a batch of our Mar 1-7 AWS marketplace usage imported as 'unattributed' in our systems. They say BuyerReference looks like the partner account id.
aj: Clarify - which field exactly is wrong? BuyerReference vs TagSet?
maya: BuyerReference is 'cloudwave-aws-acc-999' in the raw CSV instead of the downstream buyer tag we expect.
leo-fin: This'll impact invoicing and partner commission splits if we don't map it back.
sophia: I pulled a sample row from their metering export and attached to the ticket. snippet:
```
TransactionId,UsageStart,UsageEnd,BuyerReference,ProductCode,Quantity,Cost
t-01,2026-03-01,2026-03-01,cloudwave-aws-acc-999,redwood-llm,1200,24.00
```
channel-partner-ops: CloudWave confirmed they had a config change on 2026-02-28 that accidentally switched to partner-account-level reporting. They provided a downstream mapping file for Mar 1-7 (downstream_customer_tag, usage_qty, cost)
aj: Eng question: where does our ingest map BuyerReference -> internal_customer_id? marketplace-ingest service, right?
sophia: Correct. marketplace-ingest checks s3://billing-mappings/marketplace/aws/buyer_to_customer.csv and uses BuyerReference as key. If string equals a partner acct we have no entry.
leo-fin: Short-term ops: we need a reconciliation and provisional credits for impacted downstream customers. Finance, can you create the credit memos once we have mapping?
maya: Yes but we need a CSV: downstream_customer_id, affected_cost, invoice_period, partner_ref, original_tx_count.
leo-fin: I'll produce that. Also include GL code and reason code for manual adjustments.
channel-partner-ops: CloudWave agreed to re-run their marketplace export with correct BuyerReference for Mar 1-7 and also sent their mapping file. They've approved provisional PO for credits while they regenerate.
aj: Engineering mitigation idea: add fallback in marketplace-ingest: if BuyerReference matches partner pattern, try partner-specific mapping file for that date range. ETA ~48hrs to patch, test, and stage-canary.
sophia: We'll also add an ingestion validation alert: if >5% of daily token usage is unmapped, fire an alert channel and create ticket automatically.
maya: Sophia, can you run a query to enumerate affected usage by downstream tag so finance can start drafting credits?
sophia: Ran quick query (example):
```
SELECT m.downstream_tag, SUM(qty) as qty, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM partner_mappings.cloudwave_mar1_7 p
JOIN marketplace_raw.aws_usage r ON r.BuyerReference = 'cloudwave-aws-acc-999'
AND p.downstream_tag = r.expected_tag -- pseudo-join since raw is unmapped
GROUP BY m.downstream_tag;
```
Results (summary): cw-cust-101 => 5,600 tokens, $112.00; cw-cust-202 => 12,800 tokens, $256.00.
leo-fin: Finance will draft provisional credits for those downstream IDs. We'll tag credits as 'provisional - pending partner re-export'.
channel-partner-ops: CloudWave also committed to running a backfill for Feb 25-28 as they suspect the change occurred then too. They will provide mapping files for both windows.
aj: I'll include unit tests to ensure buyer_to_customer CSV lookup is deterministic and add a fallback branch that can reference partner-provided mapping artifacts.
sophia: Opening PR for ingestion validation + metrics in runbook. Will add alert runbook steps: who to ping, how to request partner re-export, and finance credit workflow.
maya: Please make sure to include the JIRA link on any generated credit memos. JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-6123
gcp-billing-bot: audit: ticket-6123 created, cloudwave_mapping_mar1-7.csv uploaded to /evidence/ticket-6123/ at 2026-03-10T14:01:12Z
leo-fin: Closing loop plan:
1) Ops get partner re-export and mapping files (in progress)
2) Eng deploy fallback + validation (48hrs)
3) Finance issue provisional credits with partner PO attached
4) Reconcile when partner re-export arrives and reverse provisional if not needed
Keep thread open until partner re-export confirmed.
maya: Thanks everyone. Assigning follow-ups in BILL-6123 and tagging @gcp-billing-bot to capture audit evidence. :white_check_mark:
